text: If our baby ends up in the special care unit for a couple of weeks after the birth, do we get any extra paid time off on top of normal parental leave?
evidence: each parent may take up to 12 weeks of neonatal leave at full pay
Neonatal leave is taken in addition to birth parent or partner leave.
answer: Yes. If the baby is admitted to neonatal care within 28 days of birth and stays 7 or more continuous days, each parent can take up to 12 weeks of neonatal leave at full pay, in addition to birth parent or partner leave.

text: Will the company chip in for a proper desk and chair now that I'm working from home part of the week?
evidence: Meridian pays a one-off home office allowance to help with furniture such as a desk and chair.
It may be claimed once every 3 years.
answer: Yes. A one-off home office allowance of £400 (UK), €450 (NL), $500 (US) or RM 1,500 (MY), claimed in Atlas with receipts within six months of becoming hybrid; it can be claimed once every 3 years.

text: Can my partner who lives with me use the counselling service too, or is it only for staff?
evidence: Family members living in the same household as the employee are also eligible to use the service.
answer: Yes. Family members living in the same household as the employee can use the Harbour Wellbeing EAP.

text: I came down with flu halfway through my week off. Do I just lose those holiday days?
evidence: If you fall ill while on annual leave, you may treat the affected days as sickness if you report it as in section 3 and provide medical evidence for the whole period.
The annual leave days are then reinstated.
answer: No. If you report the sickness as required and provide medical evidence for the whole period, the affected days are treated as sickness and the annual leave is reinstated.

text: I think my boss is fiddling the numbers and I don't want to raise it with him. Who else can I go to, ideally without giving my name?
evidence: the Meridian Speak Up portal, operated independently by VeritasLine and available 24 hours a day in English, Dutch and Malay, which allows anonymous reporting and two-way anonymous messaging
The Speak Up Officer is Hannah Brightwell, General Counsel.
answer: Use the Speak Up channels: the Meridian Speak Up portal run by VeritasLine (anonymous reporting allowed), speakup@meridian-instruments.example, or the VeritasLine hotline for your country; the Speak Up Officer is General Counsel Hannah Brightwell.

text: If Meridian pays for my accountancy exams and I leave for another job soon after finishing, will I have to pay the money back?
evidence: Within 12 months of completion
100% of fees
Within 24 months of completion
50% of fees
answer: Yes, under the F-265 agreement: 100% of fees if you leave within 12 months of completion, 50% within 24 months, nothing after 24 months.

text: Is there any extra pay for working the overnight shift on the Penang production floor?
evidence: Employees on the night shift receive a night-shift allowance of RM 15 per shift.
answer: Yes, a night-shift allowance of RM 15 per shift (day and afternoon shifts attract no allowance).

text: I'm a G6 and keep staying late to hit deadlines. Can I claim paid overtime for those extra hours?
evidence: Paid overtime applies to employees in grades G1 to G4 only.
Employees in grade G5 and above are expected to manage their working time flexibly and are not paid for additional hours
answer: No. Paid overtime is only for grades G1 to G4; G5 and above are not paid for extra hours, though managers may agree time off in lieu for exceptional periods.

text: My offer says it's conditional on checks. What are they actually going to check before I can start?
evidence: Right to work in the country of employment.
Two satisfactory references, at least one from the most recent employer.
Verification of qualifications that are essential for the role.
answer: Right to work, two satisfactory references (one from the most recent employer), verification of essential qualifications and any required professional registration; some roles also need enhanced credit and criminal record checks.

text: I've just joined the Austin office. Is money going to start going into my retirement account without me doing anything?
evidence: New hires are automatically enrolled at a pre-tax contribution of 4% of eligible pay 30 days after their hire date unless they make a different election or opt out before then.
answer: Yes. New US hires are automatically enrolled in the 401(k) at 4% pre-tax contribution 30 days after their hire date unless they elect otherwise or opt out.

text: Do I have to fill anything in to get Meridian's extra top-up on my EPF in Penang?
evidence: Meridian tops up the employer contribution to 16% for all employees, regardless of salary.
The top-up is paid into your EPF account together with the statutory contribution, so there is nothing you need to do to receive it.
answer: No. Meridian automatically tops up the employer EPF contribution to 16% for everyone; nothing needs to be done.

text: If I resign in May, do I still get my annual bonus in June?
evidence: Employees who have resigned or are under notice on the payment date do not receive a payout.
answer: No. Employees who have resigned or are under notice on the MIP payment date do not receive a payout.

text: How often can my manager put me on the out-of-hours phone rota before I can push back?
evidence: No employee should be on the on-call rota for more than one week in every three without their agreement.
answer: No more than one week in every three without your agreement.

text: I joined Meridian in February 2025. Am I in line for a raise in this year's pay review?
evidence: Employees must have joined Meridian before 1 January 2025 to be eligible for a review increase.
answer: No. Only employees who joined before 1 January 2025 are eligible for the 2025 review increase.

text: Does Meridian pay anything towards my heating and broadband bills on the days I work from home?
evidence: Meridian does not reimburse household running costs such as heating, electricity or broadband.
answer: No. Household running costs such as heating, electricity and broadband are not reimbursed (UK staff may be able to claim tax relief from HMRC).

text: How long is the probation period at Meridian?
evidence: Probation length
6 months
2 months
90-day introductory period
3 months
answer: It depends on the country: UK 6 months, Netherlands 2 months, US 90-day introductory period, Malaysia 3 months.

text: What is form F-412 and who approves it for a £50,000 purchase?
evidence: the requisitioner must complete form F-412 Single Source Justification and attach it to the requisition
The F-412 is approved by the Head of Procurement for purchases up to £75,000 and by the CFO for purchases above £75,000.
answer: F-412 is the Single Source Justification form; for a £50,000 purchase it is approved by the Head of Procurement (the CFO approves above £75,000), in addition to normal financial approval.

text: What is CC-2210 and who holds its budget?
evidence: TesseraCloud Operations
Head of Cloud Operations
answer: CC-2210 is TesseraCloud Operations in Austin (USD); the budget holder is the Head of Cloud Operations.

text: Which ap- mailbox do Rotterdam suppliers send their invoices to?
evidence: Netherlands (Rotterdam)       ap-nl@meridian-instruments.example
Send invoices as PDF attachments, one invoice per PDF, to the mailbox for the entity that issued the PO
answer: ap-nl@meridian-instruments.example (PDF, one invoice per PDF).

text: Where in Keel do I submit an F-318?
evidence: Keel > Requests > Work From Abroad
Requests to work from abroad are made through Keel > Requests > Work From Abroad using form F-318.
answer: Keel > Requests > Work From Abroad (F-318 is the Work From Abroad Request).

text: What format does a Meridian PO number have? A supplier sent an invoice quoting PO-12345.
evidence: PO numbers have the format PO-45xxxxxxxx: the letters PO, a hyphen, and a 10-digit number that always starts with 45.
Purchase order numbers are ten digits beginning with 45 and are shown in the form PO-45xxxxxxxx.
answer: PO- followed by a 10-digit number starting with 45 (e.g. PO-4500123456); PO-12345 is not valid, and invoices without a valid PO are returned unpaid.

text: What's the Keel path for claiming a non-panel GP visit in Penang?
evidence: you can claim reimbursement through Keel > Claims > Medical
Penang employees have an additional menu, Keel > Claims > Medical, for reimbursement of outpatient medical costs at non-panel clinics.
answer: Keel > Claims > Medical, uploading the receipt and medical certificate within 30 days of the visit.

text: Which Beacon ticket category do I raise for a suspected personal data breach?
evidence: by raising a ticket in Beacon under the category "Security Incident – Personal Data"
SEC-INCIDENT-PD
answer: "Security Incident – Personal Data" (code SEC-INCIDENT-PD, priority P1), raised within 2 hours of becoming aware.

text: What is the access code MERIDIAN25 used for?
evidence: To register on the Harbour Wellbeing website or app, use the access code MERIDIAN25.
answer: It is the access code for registering on the Harbour Wellbeing (EAP) website or app.

text: What is GS-02 and how often does it need redoing?
evidence: Anyone entering the Halcyon calibration lab must first complete the gas-safety induction GS-02
The GS-02 induction must be refreshed every two years.
answer: GS-02 is the gas-safety induction required before entering the Halcyon calibration lab (Leeds, Building C); it must be refreshed every two years.

text: What's the phone number for Northwind Travel Management if I'm stuck abroad?
evidence: In an emergency while travelling, call the Northwind Travel Management 24/7 line on +44 113 496 0735.

text: I'm a G6. Roughly what percentage of my salary should I expect as my FY2024/25 bonus?
evidence: Senior/Lead
The Board has approved a Meridian Incentive Plan (MIP) payout factor of 92% of target for FY2024/25.
answer: About 11.04% of base salary earned in FY2024/25 (12% G6–G7 MIP target x 92% payout factor), paid with June 2025 payroll.

text: We need to buy £60,000 of test equipment. How many quotes do we need and who has to approve the requisition?
evidence: Three written quotes
for example, a £60,000 requisition is approved by the budget holder, the Head of Department and the CFO.
answer: Three written quotes (the £10,000–£75,000 band), and approval by the budget holder, the Head of Department and the CFO.

text: A £90,000 spare-parts order can only come from the original manufacturer. What approvals does it need?
evidence: The F-412 is approved by the Head of Procurement for purchases up to £75,000 and by the CFO for purchases above £75,000.
This approval is in addition to, not instead of, the normal financial approval of the requisition under POL-FIN-003.
answer: An F-412 Single Source Justification approved by the CFO (above £75,000), plus normal requisition approval by budget holder, Head of Department and CFO (£50,000.01–£250,000 band).

text: I took a client out for dinner and it came to £90 a head. Can I claim all of it, and is there anything else I need to do?
evidence: £75 per head
Spend above the client entertainment limit is not reimbursed unless approved in advance by the budget holder.
must be recorded in the Gifts and Hospitality Register using form F-140 within 5 working days of the gift or event
answer: Only up to the £75 per head client entertainment limit unless the budget holder approved more in advance; and because it exceeds £75 per person it must be recorded on F-140 in the Gifts and Hospitality Register within 5 working days.

text: I referred a friend who's just been hired into a G6 role in Rotterdam. How much will I get and when?
evidence: The bonus is paid in full after the referred hire successfully completes probation at their site.
In the Netherlands, 2 months is the maximum probation period permitted for permanent contracts under Dutch law
answer: €3,500, paid through your payroll in the month after your friend passes the 2-month NL probation.

text: My manager approved my UK expense claim in Atlas on 14 May 2025. When will the money land?
evidence: Mon 12 May 2025
Wed 25 Jun 2025
Claims approved after the expense cut-off are paid the following month.
an approved claim that misses a cut-off is paid in the following pay run
answer: With the June payroll on Wednesday 25 June 2025, because it missed the 12 May 2025 expense cut-off.

text: I'm a UK G8 on the car allowance and drive my own car to customer sites. What do I get for the allowance and what mileage rate can I claim?
evidence: Employees who receive a car allowance or a company car must not claim the standard private car mileage rate set out in the Travel and Expense Policy (POL-FIN-007).
HMRC Advisory Fuel Rate for the car's engine size and fuel, or Advisory Electric Rate
answer: £7,800 a year car allowance (G8–G9), and business mileage at the HMRC Advisory Fuel (or Electric) Rate, not the 45p standard rate.

text: I need a hotel in Amsterdam for a trade show. What's the most I can spend a night, and how do I book something over that?
evidence: Amsterdam
Out-of-policy bookings need budget holder approval in Atlas before they are ticketed.
Go to Atlas > Travel > Book Trip.
answer: €210 per night; book through Atlas > Travel > Book Trip (Northwind Travel Management), and anything above the cap is an out-of-policy booking needing budget holder approval in Atlas before ticketing.

text: A piece of kit costs £3,000 and I want to put it on my corporate card this year. Can I, and if not, what's the route and who signs it off?
evidence: A purchase that would exceed the single transaction limit must not be put on the card.
Single transaction
Where a purchase is not permitted on a corporate card it must follow this manual.
answer: No. The card single transaction limit is £2,500, so it must be raised as a purchase requisition in Atlas under the Procurement Manual; at £3,000 it is within the budget holder's £10,000 approval limit.

text: I manage a team of G6s in Leeds. When are my salary review proposals due and what's the budget I'm working to?
evidence: G6–G7 Senior/Lead
answer: Proposals are due 16 May 2025 (calibration 27–29 May, letters 16 June); the UK review budget is 3.5% (plus a separate 0.5% promotion and equity fund).

text: One of my UK G5 engineers has resigned. How much notice do they owe, what do I need to do first on the leaver form, and how long will their personnel file be kept?
evidence: G4–G7
2 months
Confirm the resignation in writing through Keel within 5 working days of receiving it.
Personnel file
6 years
answer: 2 months' notice (G4–G7); confirm the resignation in writing through Keel within 5 working days on the F-110 Leaver Checklist; the personnel file is kept for 6 years after leaving.

text: I did a weekend on-call day in Rotterdam in June 2025. How much is it worth and by when does the claim need approving to be paid that month?
evidence: Overtime, on-call and shift allowances are claimed on F-340 and approved by the line manager in Keel.
Thu 12 Jun 2025
answer: €70 for the weekend day, claimed on F-340 and approved in Keel by the NL change cut-off (Thursday 12 June 2025 for June pay on 24 June); otherwise paid the following month.

text: What do you get for reaching ten years at Meridian?
evidence: £1,000 plus 5 extra days of leave (one-off)
The extra days of leave are a one-off addition to your entitlement and should be taken within 12 months of the anniversary.
answer: £1,000 plus 5 extra days of leave (one-off), to be taken within 12 months of the anniversary.

text: I've lost my building badge for the second time this year. Who do I tell and will it cost me?
evidence: report the loss to the site security desk at security@meridian-instruments.example within 24 hours so that it can be deactivated
A second replacement within 12 months costs £15 (or the local currency equivalent), which is deducted from pay with your agreement.
answer: Report it to security@meridian-instruments.example within 24 hours; a second replacement within 12 months costs £15 (or local equivalent), deducted from pay with your agreement.

text: What should I do if an official at a border checkpoint threatens me and demands cash before letting our shipment through?
evidence: The only exception is where a payment is demanded under duress, meaning that you reasonably believe your personal safety or liberty is at immediate risk.
make the payment, keep yourself safe, and report it to Legal and Compliance within 24 hours
answer: Facilitation payments are banned, but under duress (risk to safety or liberty) you may pay, keep safe and report it to Legal and Compliance within 24 hours; it will not be treated as a disciplinary matter.

text: Can we take a regulator from a water utility out for lunch, or give them a small gift?
evidence: You must not give any gift to a public official other than Meridian-branded promotional items of nominal value under £25
Any hospitality for a public official, whatever its value, including a working lunch, requires prior approval from the General Counsel.
answer: Only Meridian-branded promotional items under £25 as gifts; any hospitality, even a working lunch, needs prior approval from the General Counsel.

text: A supplier emailed asking us to pay into a new bank account. What checks are required before AP pays them?
evidence: must be verified by call-back to a known telephone number held on file or independently sourced, never a number supplied in the request itself
After a change of bank details, the first payment to the new account is held for 5 working days before release
answer: Verify by call-back to a number already on file, enter the change with a two-person check, and hold the first payment to the new account for 5 working days; email-only or urgent requests should be reported to IT Security.

text: Which suppliers have to fill in the sustainability questionnaire every year?
evidence: Suppliers with an annual spend over £500,000 must complete the Supplier Sustainability Questionnaire (SSQ) annually.
Procurement issues the SSQ each June and expects responses within 30 days.
answer: Suppliers with annual spend over £500,000; the SSQ is issued each June with responses expected within 30 days.

text: A Penang employee has asked for a copy of all the personal data we hold on them. Which policy sets our response deadline, and what is it?
evidence: For Malaysian data subjects, the Personal Data Protection Act requires a response within 21 days.
answer: 21 days under the Malaysian PDPA, per the Data Protection Policy (POL-CORP-006, section 7.1); UK/NL requests get one calendar month.

text: We want to roll out software that tracks staff keystrokes and app usage. What do we need before switching it on?
evidence: A data protection impact assessment (DPIA) is required before Meridian introduces any new HR monitoring tool
The DPIA must be signed off by the DPO before the tool is purchased or switched on.
answer: A DPIA signed off by the DPO before purchase or switch-on (in NL the privacy lead also checks if works council consent is needed).

text: What's the maximum fee we'll pay a recruitment agency for a permanent hire?
evidence: The agency fee is capped at 15% of base salary for permanent placements.
Only agencies on the preferred supplier list may be engaged, and only on Meridian's standard agency terms.
answer: 15% of base salary, and only agencies on the preferred supplier list on Meridian's standard terms.

text: I'm being offered a job that means moving from Leeds to Rotterdam. How much relocation support is there and what if I leave after a year and a half?
evidence: For international moves, Meridian will reimburse eligible costs of up to £20,000.
100% is repayable if they leave within 12 months of their start date, and 50% if they leave within 24 months
answer: Up to £20,000 for an international move (visa costs paid separately); leaving voluntarily after 18 months means repaying 50%.

text: How long do I have to submit an expense claim after spending the money?
evidence: Claims must be submitted within 60 days of the date the expense was incurred.
answer: 60 days from the date the expense was incurred.

text: How many days a week am I expected to be in the office as a hybrid worker?
evidence: Hybrid employees are expected to work from their contracted Meridian office for a minimum of 3 days per week.
Tuesday and Thursday are anchor days at Leeds, Rotterdam and Austin
answer: At least 3 days a week, with Tuesday and Thursday as anchor days (12 office days in any four weeks).

text: How much paid leave does the non-birthing partner get when a baby arrives, and when must it be taken?
evidence: Partners receive 6 weeks of partner leave at full pay.
The leave may be taken in blocks of at least one week at any time within 12 months of the birth or placement.
answer: 6 weeks at full pay, taken in blocks of at least a week any time within 12 months of the birth or placement.

text: I've been with the company two years. How long will I get full pay if I'm off sick?
evidence: 1 to 3 years
10 weeks
After the full-pay period, company sick pay continues at half pay for a period of the same length.
answer: 10 weeks at full pay, followed by 10 weeks at half pay.

text: Who approves a £40,000 purchase requisition?
evidence: Head of Department (G8+)
Each level also requires the approval of the levels below it
answer: The Head of Department (G8 or above), in addition to the budget holder.

text: What are the spending limits on the corporate card?
evidence: Single transaction limit increased from £2,000 to £2,500.
Monthly spend limit increased from £5,000 to £7,500.
answer: £2,500 per transaction and £7,500 per month (local-currency equivalent outside the UK); cash withdrawals not permitted.

text: Can I take out cash on my company card when I'm travelling somewhere that doesn't take cards?
evidence: Cash withdrawals are blocked on all cards.
Where cash is unavoidable while travelling, pay personally and claim through Atlas > Expenses > New Claim with a receipt.
answer: No. Cash withdrawals are blocked on all corporate cards; pay personally and claim through Atlas with a receipt.

text: After I report a concern through the whistleblowing channels, how quickly should I hear back?
evidence: The Speak Up Officer will acknowledge your report within 5 working days of receipt.
You will receive feedback on the action taken or planned within 3 months of the acknowledgement.
answer: Acknowledgement within 5 working days, and feedback within 3 months of the acknowledgement.

text: How many days a year can I work from another country, and how much notice do I have to give?
evidence: Employees may work temporarily from a country other than the one in which they are employed for up to 20 working days per year
at least 3 weeks before the first day abroad
answer: Up to 20 working days a year, with the F-318 request submitted at least 3 weeks before the first day abroad.

text: When am I allowed to book first class on the train?
evidence: First class may be booked where the scheduled journey time exceeds 4 hours, or where an advance first class ticket is cheaper than the flexible standard fare.
answer: Only when the scheduled journey exceeds 4 hours, or when an advance first class ticket is cheaper than the flexible standard fare.

text: How many days of annual leave does a new starter at the Penang site get?
evidence: Under 2 years
answer: 16 days (under 2 years' service), plus public holidays.

text: For UK staff, by when do carried-over holiday days have to be used?
evidence: Carried-over days must be used by 30 June of the new leave year; any carried-over days not used by 30 June are lost.
answer: By 30 June of the new leave year (up to 5 days can be carried over).

text: How much unused PTO can Austin employees roll over at year end?
evidence: US employees may carry over a maximum of 5 days (40 hours) of unused PTO into the next leave year.
Any balance above 40 hours on March 31 is forfeited.
answer: Up to 5 days (40 hours); anything above 40 hours on 31 March is forfeited.

text: King's Day 2025 is on a Saturday. Do Rotterdam employees get another day off instead?
evidence: Saturday 26 April 2025 (falls on a Saturday)
When a public holiday falls on a weekend, no replacement day is given.
answer: No. King's Day falls on Saturday 26 April 2025 and no replacement day is given in the Netherlands.

text: Is December 2025 pay brought forward for Penang staff like it is in Leeds?
evidence: Unlike the UK and NL payrolls, Penang December pay is not brought forward and is paid on Friday 26 December 2025.
answer: No. Penang December pay is paid on Friday 26 December 2025.

text: What's the monthly payroll change cut-off for the Netherlands?
evidence: must be fully approved by the 12th of the month to be included in that month's payroll
answer: The 12th of the month (previous working day if the 12th is not a working day).

text: What's the EAP counselling helpline number for staff in Malaysia?
answer: 1-800-81-6620 (Harbour Wellbeing).

text: What number do US employees call to report a Speak Up concern by phone?
answer: 1-855-555-0142 (VeritasLine hotline).

text: For Rotterdam employees, when do unused statutory holiday days expire?
evidence: Statutory days not taken in the leave year expire on 1 July of the following year (six months after the end of the leave year).
Extra-statutory days expire 5 years after the end of the leave year in which they were accrued.
answer: On 1 July of the following year; extra-statutory days last 5 years.

text: How and when are expense claims reimbursed for Austin employees?
evidence: Expense claims approved in Atlas are reimbursed by a separate ACH payment every Wednesday.
Claims approved by 17:00 CT on Monday are included in that week's Wednesday run.
answer: Not through payroll: by a separate ACH payment every Wednesday, covering claims approved by 17:00 CT on the Monday.

text: What are the current per-diem and hotel limits for a trip to London?
evidence: London
answer: £65 per day for meals and £210 per night for the hotel.

text: What is the UK salary range for a G7?
How much life cover do Netherlands employees get?
evidence: Life cover
3x salary
answer: 3x salary.

text: What are the standard weekly working hours for a full-timer in Malaysia?
evidence: Malaysia
answer: 44 hours per week.

answer: Meridian pays 6%, making 10% in total.

text: In the 401(k), what match do I get if I contribute 5%?
answer: 4.5% company match, 9.5% in total.

evidence: Expense claims and receipts
7 years
after claim paid

evidence: G8–G9
Chief People Officer and CFO
answer: The Chief People Officer and the CFO (plus CPO approval for any offer above midpoint).

evidence: First written warning
6 months
Final written warning

answer: Day 30, day 60 and day 85 of the 90-day introductory period.

evidence: Meridian Penang observes 14 paid public holidays each year, drawn from the federal and Penang state gazetted holidays.
answer: 14 paid public holidays.

text: What date in the month do we get paid?
evidence: The standard pay date is the 24th of each month.
answer: The 24th of each month (previous working day if it falls on a weekend or Dutch public holiday).

evidence: UK employees may buy up to 5 additional days of annual leave through the flexible benefits scheme.
You can buy up to 5 days of additional annual leave.
answer: Yes, up to 5 extra days through the flexible benefits window.

text: How many sick days do I get a year, and is it separate from my vacation?
evidence: US employees receive 7 days (56 hours) of paid sick time per leave year, separate from PTO.
answer: 7 days (56 hours) of paid sick time per year, separate from PTO.

text: Under this version of the policy, what was the nightly hotel cap in New York?
evidence: New York
answer: $320 per night (version 1, 2024).
